name: Flagger Progressive Delivery Self-Hosted
free_limit: Apache-2.0 open-source Kubernetes progressive delivery operator supporting automated canary, A/B, and blue/green rollouts with metrics-based promotion and rollback; no vendor-imposed software deployment quota.
watch_out: Requires a Kubernetes cluster, compatible ingress controller/service mesh or Gateway API, monitoring metrics, and deployment operations. Cluster, load balancer, observability and network resources may cost extra; this is not a managed hosted CD plan.
